##### Project general facts

Creek Vistas Grande presents the last Downtown-facing apartments at Sobha Hartland, offering a collection of urbane and refined one, two, and three-bedroom residences. This exceptional development features three distinct advantages: uninterrupted views, exceptional quality, and an abundance of amenities. Exceptionally designed spacious apartments with the splendid view of the Dubai skyline allow residents to live every movement of their life, perfectly encapsulating what the community represents in terms of elegance of design and luxury of convenience.

Residents enjoy a range of exclusive amenities under one roof, including a kids' play area, a fully equipped gymnasium, a swimming pool, a landscaped pathway, a barbecue area, and a meditation zone. The development offers a view of infinite expanse from every room, with uninterrupted views encompassing Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, and Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. Every amenity is designed to elevate the living experience, creating a perfect gateway to the self-contained world of Sobha Hartland.

Every residence at Creek Vistas Grande features exceptionally designed spacious layouts with the splendid view of the Dubai skyline. The interiors are crafted with Sobha's signature quality, reflecting a commitment to excellence that is as unique in build as in design. Large size apartments allow residents to live every movement of their life, with kitchens fully equipped and every detail reflecting the highest standards of craftsmanship.

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled in MBR City, one of the leading investment destinations in Dubai, this exceptional location offers a waterfront boardwalk with retail and restaurant experiences. Situated in the centre of Dubai, the community is just minutes away from Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, and within easy reach of International Airport and Palm Jumeirah.

The location is distinguished by its abundant green and open spaces, with over two million square feet of green areas across the community, including three lush green parks connected by a central pathway. Two international schools within the community have been functional for over four years, while the location offers attractive rates of return with ROI of up to eight percent across products.

For those seeking a residence that embodies urbane elegance, exceptional quality, and a prime Dubai address, Sobha Hartland delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, abundant green spaces, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
